_comment: STRUCTURAL SIGNALS ONLY. recommendation, base_case_return, expected_value, and all scenario prices/EPS are DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: they are derived from Pass 1 (LLM, sampled at temperature 1.0) and vary run-to-run (e.g. NVDA swung PASS<->BUY between two identical-input batches), so freezing them would make this golden flaky. Only reproducible structural/audit signals are frozen here.
